title: Wave Functions
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the wave functions for the three lowest states of the two-dimensional harmonic oscillator.

title: Energy Values
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct energy values corresponding to the identified wave functions.

title: Perturbation Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly compute the first order energy corrections due to the perturbation.

title: Degeneracy Handling
description: Important Criteria: The student must recognize and appropriately handle the degeneracy of the states when calculating perturbation effects.

title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the corrected energies after applying perturbation theory.

title: Integral Evaluation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include a correct evaluation of the integrals involved in the perturbation calculation.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign errors in the calculations of energy corrections.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
